title: The selection outline follows a rounded shape
goal: Round a rectangle right up and the dashed outline that says it is selected stays a hard rectangle, so it stands off the shape at every corner. It should trace the shape you have picked, the way it does on a square one.
notes: Seen while auditing corner radius on 2026-09-08: queue/audits/2026-09-08-corner-radius-4-zoomed-sc.png shows the dashed rect cutting across the corners of a 49pt rounded box at 156%. Reproduce with Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/corner-radius-rounds-walk.json and look at 6-zoomed-sc.png. The outline is drawn in Sources/Photonz/CanvasDisplay.swift (inkCorners / the selection frame path). Layer.boxCornerRadius(boxSize:) in PhotonzCore/CornerRadiusSelection.swift is the curve to follow, and it is what the renderer rings with. It is a judgement call whether the outline marks the FRAME (as now) or the INK, so it may want the user asked rather than just changed.
acceptance: Selecting a rounded rectangle draws its selection outline round the same curve the shape has, at every zoom
A square shape, an ellipse, a line and an arrow are marked exactly as they are today
The handles stay on the frame corners, since that is where a drag grabs
A test covers the shape of the outline for a rounded rectangle
